name: Joshua
overview: Joshua, also called Jehoshua and Oshea, was the son of Nun and closely associated with Moses as his servant and minister. Scripture highlights his faithfulness and courage, showing him as a young man who remained in the tabernacle and supported Moses, even responding to challenges within the camp. He was a military leader who discomfited Amalek and his people, demonstrating God’s empowerment in battle. Joshua’s role as Moses’ successor is underscored by his intimate involvement in key moments, such as accompanying Moses up Mount God and recognizing the significance of the people’s movements, preparing him to lead Israel into the Promised Land.
